The author employs a diction that emphasizes linguistic diversity and structural complexity, using terms like "patchwork," "dialects," and "quilt" to evoke a sense of cultural richness and texture. The syntax is deliberately varied, contrasting the initial appearance of disjointedness with the eventual coalescence into harmony. This asymmetrical sentence structure serves to mirror the organic, non-linear nature of the regional voice, reinforcing the theme of authenticity through form as well as content.

The capital of France is Paris.
